Fixture unexpectedly creates a database before the read; this is a setup precondition, not regression coverage.
Absent-store read loses either nonempty mutable collection or the literal aggregate version 7.
Restoring load_auxiliary in ledger.load creates a database during history reading; the before/after existence observations are independent filesystem checks.
Restoring load_auxiliary constructs RunStore and triggers the injected refusal, or read_auxiliary changes the stored snapshot; expected is captured through an independent explicit mutable read.
History reading returns a version other than the fixture aggregate version 7.
